from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/zainabe-hazineman.md')
original = p.read_text()
_, metadata, body = original.split('---\\n', 2)
header, roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
header = header.replace('Zainabe Hazineman', 'Zainab-e-Hazin-e-Man')
changes = {
    'Khwahara': 'Khwaahara', 'khwahara': 'khwaahara', 'khuda': 'Khuda',
    'behen': 'bahan', 'zainab': 'Zainab', 'dureeda': 'darida',
    'alamdaram': 'alamdaaram', 'bemueeno beyaram': 'be muin o be yaaram',
    'hayate bezaaram': 'hayaat-e-bezaaram', 'hawale': 'hawaale',
    'laayeq': 'laaiq', 'uske': 'us ke', 'nana': 'naana', 'lutaya': 'lutaaya',
    'tarha': 'tarah', 'nawase': 'nawaase', 'nibhaya': 'nibhaaya',
    'ghabrana': 'ghabraana', 'Abbas e jari': 'Abbaas-e-jari',
    'takrana': 'takraana', 'E jaan o dil e hyder': 'Ae jaan o dil-e-Haidar',
    'bacha lena': 'bachaa lena', 'sakina': 'Sakina', 'godi': 'godi',
    'sula lena': 'sulaa lena', 'Kamsin': 'Kam sin', 'baad mere Zainab': 'baad mere Zainab',
    'ko hai khanjar': 'ko hai khanjar',
}
for old, new in changes.items():
    roman = re.sub(r'(?<"'!['"\\w-])' + re.escape(old) + r'(?"'!['"\\w-])', lambda _: new, roman)
roman = roman.replace('ye sakina', 'ye Sakina')
roman = roman.replace('naize', 'neze').replace('Alwida', 'Alwidaa').replace('alwida', 'alwidaa')
assert len(roman.splitlines()) == len(body.strip().splitlines()) == 34
updated = '---\\n' + header + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman + '---\\n' + body
assert updated.split('---\\n', 2)[2] == body
p.write_text(updated)
PY

from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/zainabe-hazineman.md')
data = p.read_bytes()
front, body = data.decode().split('\\n---\\n', 1)
changes = {
'Zainabe Hazineman':'Zainab-e-Hazin-e-Man', 'Alwida':'Alwidaa', 'alwida':'alwidaa',
'Khwahara':'Khwaahara', 'khwahara':'khwaahara', 'khuda':'Khuda',
'behen':'bahan', 'zainab':'Zainab', 'dureeda':'darida', 'alamdaram':'alamdaaram',
'bemueeno beyaram':'be muin o be yaaram', 'hayate bezaaram':'hayaat-e-bezaaram',
'hawale':'hawaale', 'laayeq':'laaiq', 'uske':'us ke', 'nana':'naana', 'lutaya':'lutaaya',
'tarha':'tarah', 'nawase':'nawaase', 'nibhaya':'nibhaaya', 'naize':'neze',
'ghabrana':'ghabraana', 'Abbas e jari':'Abbaas-e-jari', 'takrana':'takraana',
'E jaan o dil e hyder':'Ae jaan o dil-e-Haidar', 'bacha lena':'bachaa lena',
'sakina':'Sakina', 'sula lena':'sulaa lena', 'Kamsin':'Kam sin',
}
for old, new in changes.items():
    front = re.sub(r'\\b' + re.escape(old) + r'\\b', new, front)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()
assert len(roman) == len(body.strip().splitlines()) == 34
assert roman[0].strip() == '1' and body.strip().splitlines()[0] == '۱'

p.write_bytes((front + '\\n---\\n' + body).encode())
assert p.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == data.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1]
